sharedStartupObserver.scope: Shared derived child only. Original startup commands, runtime assets, session wrapper, source and FAS unchanged. Completed pre-READY stdout lines are scanned for anchored fatal diagnostics and existing marker order. One bounded receipt; no TRACE/CPU/FS observer or per-line timestamps/messages. Does not prove a same-evaluation root-load return. Original stdout tail is bounded to 16384 characters; console stderr is retained separately.

scope: No-rebuild source STACK comparison of accepted ecl-oz and the flattened production candidate. Both use identical pinned source files, classifier startup, session/child wrappers and controlled programs. n10 per profile/mode/CPU condition, five AB and five BA orders. Fresh browser/profile per cold pair and new terminated/recreated workers for same-profile reload. Existing bounded stdout observer and load markers are identical in both arms. No CPU/FS profiling; no samples omitted. Source files and runtime assets are hashed before staging. Historical old artifact is a profile control, not a byte-identical published-v2 timing. No compiled STACK sample is timed in this run.
